account.title: Account

landing.title: Lunch on budget, delivered before your break
landing.subtitle: Say how much you have or how many calories you want. Lo2ma searches the restaurants around your office and suggests 3 options with the full bill. Nothing is ordered until you confirm and pay.
landing.ctaNote: No sign-up needed. You sign in only to pay.

preview.label: An example from the chat
preview.agent: I found 3 options near your office. This one is the best value:

say.title: Say what you have
say.body: A budget like “I have 200”, a calorie target like “under 600 kcal”, and what you don't eat.

pick.title: Pick from 3
pick.body: Every suggestion shows the full bill with delivery, the calories and their source, and the arrival time.

pay.title: Confirm and pay
pay.body: The order goes to the restaurant only after you pay, and you track it until it arrives before your break.

week.title: Plan the whole week's lunches in one go
week.body: Sunday to Thursday on one budget. Lo2ma orders each day on time, and you can change any day until {time} AM that day.
week.onePayment: One payment for the whole week

noAiPay.title: The AI never pays
noAiPay.body: Lo2ma only suggests. Only you can confirm and pay.

calorieSource.title: Calories with their source
calorieSource.body: Every calorie number says where it comes from: the restaurant or an AI estimate.

fullBill.title: The full bill up front
fullBill.body: See the food, delivery and service before you confirm. Minimum order: {amount} on food.

end.title: Hungry? Say how much you have.
end.body: Lo2ma does the rest, and you decide.

landing.demoNote: Demo: the restaurants and orders aren't real.

seo.title: Lo2ma · Lunch on budget, delivered before your break
